knowledge.name: Synthetic authorization request records
knowledge.detail: Fixed fictional requests provide service, payer, source-recorded state, date, policy reference, and present or missing evidence.

knowledge.name: Synthetic payer policy checklists
knowledge.detail: Bundled fictional imaging and procedure checklists provide named requirements and effective dates for evidence review only.

knowledge.name: Healthcare review rules and controls
knowledge.detail: Packaged guidance separates evidence organization from clinical judgment, medical necessity, eligibility, and authorization outcomes.

knowledge.name: Operation skills and locked evidence anchors
knowledge.detail: Four skills define natural-language routing, source-backed procedures, exact demo evidence, safety language, and reviewer gates.

intelligence_processing.name: Request evidence inventory
intelligence_processing.detail: Organizes source-backed clinical and administrative evidence and identifies missing fields without submitting or deciding a request.

intelligence_processing.name: Criteria-to-evidence crosswalk
intelligence_processing.detail: Presents payer checklist requirements beside available evidence while reserving policy interpretation and medical necessity for reviewers.

intelligence_processing.name: Source-recorded status transcription
intelligence_processing.detail: Reports the workflow state and source date as recorded, explicitly distinguishing that evidence from an agent determination.

intelligence_processing.name: Reconsideration evidence drafting
intelligence_processing.detail: Builds a minimum-necessary outline for reviewer consideration without recommending, filing, or claiming an appeal is appropriate.

intelligence_processing.name: Deterministic intent routing and failure handling
intelligence_processing.detail: Maps persona-language requests to four bounded operations and returns no substituted record when a synthetic identifier is unknown.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio review workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides a natural-language Draft agent with four operation skills, two synthetic knowledge files, and web search removed.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat and API
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file RAPP tool through local chat, streaming, health, and agent endpoints using bundled synthetic data.

clients_user_interface.name: Role-based evidence review experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Utilization coordinators, nurse case managers, and schedulers receive compact evidence outputs with explicit reviewer ownership.

management_reporting.name: Authorization evidence inventory report
management_reporting.detail: Shows request identity, payer, source state, policy reference, and present or missing evidence for utilization review.

management_reporting.name: Payer criteria checklist review
management_reporting.detail: Lists policy title, effective date, and reviewer checks without asserting that evidence establishes eligibility or medical necessity.

management_reporting.name: Recorded workflow status brief
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes source-recorded authorization states and dates without predicting, granting, denying, or changing an outcome.

management_reporting.name: Reconsideration evidence outline
management_reporting.detail: Presents minimum-necessary evidence and policy references while qualified reviewers retain rationale, completeness, and submission control.

tools.name: Portable PriorAuthorizationAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent implements four deterministic, read-only operations over bundled synthetic requests and policies.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable tool and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and agent endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the validated Draft package, four skills, and two synthetic knowledge files; publication requires separate confirmation.

tools.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
tools.detail: Provides a governed conversational front door for evidence questions when the solution is deployed through approved channels.

tools.name: Approved read-only EHR or FHIR source
tools.detail: Future least-privilege seam for clinical evidence; the current package has no live connection and uses fictional records only.

tools.name: Approved payer policy source
tools.detail: Future governed seam for current criteria; qualified payer or utilization reviewers must verify authoritative policy.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams utilization-review coordination
tools.detail: Future collaboration seam for human review; the package sends no messages, approval requests, submissions, or notifications.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The deployment environment supplies the model for conversational routing and evidence drafting within the packaged controls.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: All people, identifiers, payers, policies, dates, records, and workflow states are fictional and limited to packaged evidence.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic read-only operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes evidence inventory, criteria crosswalk, recorded status, and reconsideration drafting to explicit bounded handlers.

supporting_features.name: Strict schema and fail-closed identifiers
supporting_features.detail: Rejects extra tool arguments and unknown request identifiers without browsing, substituting, or inventing clinical or payer facts.

supporting_features.name: Clinical and payer reviewer authority
supporting_features.detail: Qualified clinical, utilization, and payer-policy reviewers retain interpretation, medical-necessity reasoning, and every outcome.

supporting_features.name: No approval or denial automation
supporting_features.detail: The agent never predicts, grants, denies, recommends, submits, or changes an authorization, eligibility result, or appeal.

supporting_features.name: Minimum-necessary privacy controls
supporting_features.detail: Outputs use only authorized minimum-necessary evidence and prohibit live patient data, diagnosis, treatment advice, and outreach.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Four isolated persona cases pass with exact evidence anchors; Copilot Studio artifacts remain Draft until separately approved.
